 Tzolis starts: Liverpool v Arsenal team news
 Premier League 
 arseblog 
 November 1, 2026 
 35 
 Arsenal are in Premier League action this afternoon, taking on Liverpool at Anfield.
 Here are today’s official line-ups.
 Liverpool : Alisson, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Kerkez, Araujo, Wirtz, Mac Allister, Gakpo, Barcola, Nyoni, Isak
 Subs : Mamardashvili, Gomez, Endo, Szoboszlai, Tsimikas, Munoz, Gravennberch, Koumas, Mgumoha
 Arsenal : Raya, Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori, Rice, Guimaraes, Odegaard, Tzolis, Madueke, Havertz
 Subs : Kepa, White, Hincapie, Mosquera, Lewis-Skelly, Zubimendi, Merino, Gyokeres, Eze
